facts.headline: $SOL Price Forecast: Short-Term Pressure, Long-Term Strength?
facts.summary: Solana's $SOL token faces short-term selling pressure from large FTX-estate unlocks, while a possible Solana ETF and strong developer and community adoption support the longer-term case. The forecast is less a price call than a study in how supply cliffs and narrative collide.
